prose: Jason Quitt returns to InnerVerse to discuss his book, Gates of the Annunaki: Sacred Geometry Keys to the Gods. We explore depth psychology and "ancient alien gods," syncretism between Sumerian and other mythologies, the Seven Sages or Kings that created civilization, universal deluge stories and buried ruins, the geometry of the solar savior, and biological measurements in pyramids and artifacts.
ext: Jason tells the stories of Gilgamesh and the descent of Inanna, parallels to Genesis, the mystical significance of 72, astrotheological encoding of Sumerian artifacts, and what makes an artifact "sacred."
links: Jason Quitt's books, The Crystal Sun
